sourceLore.details: Dry cracked aqueduct channel; empty buckets; bootprints follow bed; broken toll gate across channel, footprints around it.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: text-free painted environment layer for AshenSpire, not a screenshot. Style: polished hand-painted dark fantasy environment illustration matching the weathered stone, iron, aged brass and restrained ember warmth of the supplied style reference. Detailed tactile brushwork, atmospheric depth, natural silhouettes, no photographic look. Do not reproduce the reference architecture literally. No people, foreground characters, NPC identities, text, lettering, UI, borders, labels, numbers, stat values, map coordinates, logos or game symbols.
Primary request: Old Aqueduct, a dry cracked medieval stone water channel repurposed as a survivor footpath. Show empty worn buckets near the channel, muddy bootprints along its bed and passing around a collapsed weathered wooden toll barrier; no water in the channel. Ancient stone arches and buttresses recede into grey mountain mist. The broken gate does not block the route around it.
Composition: landscape desktop painting. Main readable channel and toll barrier occupy left and center, with the path drawing the eye into the distance. Reserve quieter dark mist/stone along the right quarter for a future inspector overlay, but paint the whole frame. Muted charcoal stone, brown timber, cool grey haze and small warm remnants only; no dramatic fire. Wide landscape.
